TZA.note: eRITA is an online application platform for certificates; no authentication service is stated.
No exchange between civil register and ID system is stated.
Only cards printed and uncollected (over 300,000) are given, not people enrolled.

facts.fact: NIDA's Director General says an Infant Registration Bill, to be tabled from 27 January 2026, would register children at birth and assign a unique identification number used to issue a national digital ID card at 18.

TZA.note: Who operates or owns the ID system is not stated.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: NIDA's Director General says more than 300,000 printed national ID cards await collection in district offices, so the authority is issuing national ID cards.
